question: Who was the founder of the Forward Bloc party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhas Chandra Bose**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** founded the Forward Bloc party in 1939.
 
• The Forward Bloc was established as a faction within the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• Bose aimed to consolidate the political left and rally radical elements within the Congress to fight against British colonial rule.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose was a prominent freedom fighter and a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He believed in complete and immediate independence for India, differing from the more moderate approach of other Congress leaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was born on January 23, 1897, in Cuttack, Odisha.
 
• He was elected as the President of the Indian National Congress in 1938 and 1939 but resigned due to differences with Mahatma Gandhi and other Congress leaders.
 
• Bose is also known for his role in leading the **Indian National Army (INA)** during World War II to fight against British rule.
 
• He is often referred to by the honorific title **Netaji**, which means "Respected Leader" in Hindi.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose's legacy continues to inspire many in India and around the world.
